title: Controller value listeners are change-gated
evidence: At frame 1 (16 ms) Flutter has 1 value notification and Incular 0, with value 0.25 in both. After the same-value assignment at frame 5 Flutter increments its count again and Incular does not. Max difference 3 across 21 frames.
impact: Controller listeners miss Flutter callbacks on the first zero-elapsed tick and on equal-value assignments. Clients using callbacks for side effects observe fewer events.
cause: Public listener dispatch shares the state-change guard used for reactive invalidation.
fix_direction: Preserve Flutter callback dispatch for every controller tick and value setter, while keeping dependency invalidation change-sensitive if the retained tree requires it.
limitations: Equal-value assignment and zero-elapsed tick are the only cases isolated; set_value mid-run in anim_core__controller_set_value_mid_run is not counted because its listener counts were not sampled.

title: First forward status notification is suppressed for an intermediate initial value
evidence: Flutter reports one status notification after forward() from 0.25; Incular reports none. Both report status forward and value 0.25.
impact: A status listener registered before the first run does not receive Flutter's initial forward transition when the controller starts at an interior value.
cause: Incular's reported-status baseline follows the initial value; Flutter's baseline stays dismissed until a status callback is dispatched.
fix_direction: Initialize the reported-status baseline independently from the current value to match Flutter's first-run notification behavior.
limitations: Only the interior-start case is compared; status-listener counts after a dismissed start are not sampled in any scenario.

title: Scheduler-wide time dilation is not implemented
evidence: Non-equivalent diagnostic: Flutter timeDilation = 2 against Incular retained-animation scale 0.5 chosen to match controller progress. At frame 2 (32 ms) Flutter reports 8,000 us and Incular's raw ticker 16,000 us.
impact: Incular callers cannot slow scheduler timestamps, ticker callbacks and self-ticking controllers together as Flutter does.
cause: Incular scales the retained widget animation clock rather than all frame timestamps; it has no scheduler-wide time-dilation API.
fix_direction: Add scheduler-level time scaling for frame timestamps, or provide an equivalent per-runtime scheduler setting that also affects tickers and frame callbacks.
limitations: Not a same-configuration comparison: the two settings are different mechanisms.

title: Derived animations cannot register Flutter-style listeners
evidence: Source review. AnimationSource (animations.rs:16-31) exposes value, status and controller access only; DoubleAnimation (:69-95) exposes reads and composition with no listener interface. Controllers have listeners; derived curved, reversed, driven and compound values do not.
impact: Callers cannot attach a listener to a derived value or status; they must listen to underlying controllers and recompute the graph themselves.
cause: Derived Incular animations are lazily sampled reactive values rather than listener-bearing Animation<T> objects.
fix_direction: Expose listener subscriptions on animation graph nodes, or provide a documented adapter that propagates value and status notifications through derived nodes.
limitations: Source-only; no listener API exists to run a frame twin against.

title: with_vsync tickers do not inherit TickerMode
evidence: Source review. A controller ticking through with_vsync() is scheduled outside a retained AnimationTicker node, so an ancestor TickerMode does not mute it automatically; the caller must call set_ticker_muted. The retained-tree mute check is animation_muted (interaction.rs:2187), and existing ticker_mode.rs tests cover retained-tree tickers only.
impact: Wrapping a self-ticking controller's subtree in TickerMode(enabled: false) does not silence that controller as Flutter's widget-aware ticker providers do.
cause: Incular's self-scheduling with_vsync ticker has no widget or environment provider connection.
fix_direction: Provide a widget-aware ticker provider that updates controller mute state from the active TickerMode, or make the ownership path explicit in the public API.
limitations: Source-only. The Flutter twin would need a TickerMode toggle during a running animation; see the harness request.
